FOXTROTTON KILOSON K

Incident page for this loss

Name: MAJ Kiloson K. Foxtrotton
Unit: 38 ARRS
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 07/19/1969; duty: Pilot.
Service: component of the U.S. Air Force
Country: Thailand
Aircraft: HH-43B tail number 59-01562
Short Summary: The HH-43B was wrecked by the blast when a B-52 that had crashed burning on the field exploded.
Burial information: SAMPLE MEMORIAL PARK, ANYTOWN
